sections.kicker: Prepared for Hijoo by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Hijoo started as a salad wrap and is becoming a coffee shop. The profile still says the first thing.
sections.keep: The word wargajoo and the hashtag. A name for your own customers is rare and it works.

meet first.

pins.why: "The #1st" asks for trust without proof, and it reads like a hashtag, not a position.
pins.how: Say what makes the wrap different in a way a person can check.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: The claim sounds like every other food brand claiming number one.

pins.quote: buat wargajoo yang udah sering beli Kopi Seasalt Hijoo
pins.what: Recent posts sell coffee as much as salad.
pins.why: Seasalt coffee and signature drinks pull the brand away from the wrap the name promises.
pins.how: Decide if Hijoo is a salad bar with coffee or a coffee shop with salad.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: Guests cannot say in one sentence what Hijoo is.

pins.what: The hashtag carries the idea of balance.
pins.why: It says why Hijoo and not a heavier lunch, and it repeats on the posts that sound most like the brand.
pins.how: Make balance the headline idea of the profile.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The one idea that is different sits in a hashtag.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Hijoo. I spent some time on what people see first. Three things stood out.
